title: Factorization machine classification model construction method and device and readable storage medium

pse.problem: Inefficient computational process during training a classification model based on federated learning due to large amounts of computation required for sparse matrix data
pse.solution_function: Performs vertical federated interaction between two devices to calculate a secret sharing classification model error, and updates the model parameters based on this error to obtain a more efficient federated factorization machine classification model
pse.solution_structure: Two devices, first sparse data corresponding to the to-be-trained classification model, secretly shared initial model parameters, preset weight information
pse.solution_implementation: Obtaining the to-be-trained model parameters and first sparse data, secret sharing of initial model parameters with a second device, calculating secret sharing classification model error through federated interaction based on the first non-zero part in the first sparse data and the secret sharing initial model parameters, updating the model parameters based on this error
pse.effect: Improved computational efficiency during training of the classification model based on federated learning
